whole_lifecycle_findings.finding: registerGoals constructs a distinct friendsGoal and schedules it priority3. hurt first rejects isInvulnerableTo. Otherwise when causing entity exists OR damage is ALWAYS_TRIGGERS_SILVERFISH and friendsGoal exists, notifyHurt executes before returning super.hurt. No local positive-amount, parent-bool, server or alive test exists in that scheduling branch. It is not a local cancel/refusal gate and no wakeup guarantee follows a rejected parent result.

The native LivingEntity parent begins a cancellable Forge livingAttack hook for a nonPlayer such as silverfish, then rejects source-invulnerability, client, dead/dying and matching fire-resistance; cooldown can later returnfalse for amount<=lastHurt. These later returnfalse paths do not roll back the earlier subclass notification. Parent effects/hurt return do not prove positive HP loss, while notification alone does not prove that a living AI consumer will ever run.

notifyHurt writes only when lookForFriends==0, using adjustedTickDelay(20). This goal inherits requiresUpdateEveryTick false, so the stored value is ceil(20/2)=10. Further notifications while positive do not refresh the counter. canUse and inherited canContinue require>0. Each actual running goal tick decrements; only at<=0 does the scan run. There is no target/source-specific bucket or original-attacker receipt.

WrappedGoal delegates flags/start/stop/tick. This friends goal supplies no flags, so its empty flag set does not conflict with movement/combat locks. GoalSelector cleans expired running goals, starts usable goals, and full tick runs all running goals. Mob alternates full goalSelector.tick with tickRunningGoals(false) using server tick+entityID except initial tick handling; non-every-tick goal is omitted from the latter branch. Therefore10 goal evaluations is not a measured wall-clock duration or a universal exact20 game-tick receipt.

When scan becomes eligible it snapshots current level/RNG/blockPosition, then iterates y offsets0,1,-1,...5,-5, x and z offsets0,1,-1,...10,-10. Finite upper bound11*21*21=4851 visited positions before early stops. Only InfestedBlock positions trigger the world modification branch and random nextBoolean early return. At each found infestation Forge mob-griefing result can override the rule: DEFAULT uses rule, ALLOW true, other result false. True requests destroyBlock(pos,true,silverfish). False still requests replacing infestation with hostStateByInfested(currentstate), so denial is not no terrain change. Both result booleans are ignored; nextBoolean may end the whole scan after that request even when the write/removal did not succeed.

The three-arg destroyBlock delegates with recursion512. Level rejects air, produces the break levelEvent, invokes Block.dropResources when requested, and only then calls setBlock with fluid legacy state; return is the final block-write flag, and BLOCK_DESTROY game event is true-gated. In ServerLevel, dropResources gets loot/popResource then invokes state.spawnAfterBreak which dispatches to block. Therefore infestation spawning may be attempted before final block removal succeeds; no crash-atomic block-to-mob transaction or exploit reproduction is claimed.

InfestedBlock.spawnAfterBreak calls super then requires RULE_DOBLOCKDROPS and SilkTouch level0 before spawnInfestation. The wake destroy path passes ItemStack.EMPTY, but actual spawn still depends on rule/create/add. spawnInfestation creates SILVERFISH, null-checks, positions it, ignores addFreshEntity result and invokes spawnAnim afterwards. This call is not a guaranteed entity-add receipt. The false-griefing host replacement path does not invoke this destroy/drop pipeline itself.

Merge-with-stone canUse requires no target and finished navigation, then Forge griefing eligibility, reducedTickDelay(10) random draw and a compatible neighboring host. start rechecks host but not the earlier griefing predicate, requests host-to-infested setBlock, then spawnAnim/discard without checking write success. State conversion copies only shared block properties into host/infested default state. No silverfish health/UUID/target/equipment serialization is stored by this conversion; later new entity creation is not restoration of that actor or earned progress.

HurtByTargetGoal.setAlertOthers is a separate registered targeting goal, not the friendsGoal block-release consumer. Its complete implementation was not read in this batch, so no automatic aggro-sharing, swarm targeting the original attacker, spawn finalization or same-type targeting guarantee is inferred from the registration line.
